text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The Fan Appreciation Festivals held in spring and autumn—
the autumn one is known as the 'Holy Hoof Festival,'
focusing primarily on cultural events like festival stalls."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are also live stages organized by volunteers.
I've heard that sometimes these interactions lead to forming official units—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for listening, everyone!!
That was the absolute best time ever!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
The five of us just happened to come together like this,
so it's kinda sad to think it's over now~.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
I haven't even shown off my hyped-up dance yet!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I haven't been able to execute the performance
of doing backflips and aerial cartwheels to the beat, either.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Wait...! 
I thought we scrapped the acrobatics...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The truth is, there was still so much more
I wanted to do at our live show.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I wonder... what about everyone else?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, I'm so happy!!
A live concert might be tough, but...
maybe we could do something with videos?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"If it's recorded on video, it can be edited,
so we could even pull off a gymnastics routine."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Bourbon... Could it be that you want to do acrobatics...?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Video footage, like a VTR tape, right?
Doesn't that sound totally cutting-edge?!
Bacchi-goo!! Let's totally do it♪"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, everyone's totally fired up too!
Which means our activities aren't over just yet!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I'll outrun saying goodbye to everyone! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Well then, see you all again at next year's Holy Hoof Festival☆

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"You've gotta be kidding me...
I'm dragged into it next year too..."
